assumptions: The dimensions satisfy m > s > n > 0, and both A and SA have full column rank.

The finite-precision sketch and Householder QR outputs satisfy BHat=SA+E1 and Qtilde*RHat=BHat+E2, Qtilde has orthonormal columns, and RHat is upper triangular with the recorded two-sided inverse RHatInv.
YHat is produced by a row-wise finite-precision forward-substitution trace for YHat*RHat=A under standard relative-error scalar operations.
The supplied spectral extrema are attained exact values, and the supplied pseudoinverses satisfy all four Moore-Penrose equations.
The source states no separate overflow, underflow, NaN, or infinity clauses for Lemma 3.2.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p07_t1_perturbed_preconditioned_map_injective {m s n : Nat} (pre : P07Lemma31ComputedPreconditioner m s n) (model : P07ScalarArithmeticModel) (run : P07Lemma32ForwardRun pre model) (exactData : P07MatrixPseudoinverseSpectralData (p07ExactPreconditionedMatrix pre)) (errorSpectrum : P07RectSpectralExtrema run.DeltaY) (computedData : P07MatrixPseudoinverseSpectralData run.forwardSubstitution.output) (hsmall : p07Lemma32Epsilon exactData errorSpectrum < 1) : And (Function.Injective (p07MatVec run.forwardSubstitution.output)) (p07ConditionNumber2 computedData <= (p07ConditionNumber2 exactData + p07Lemma32Epsilon exactData errorSpectrum) / (1 - p07Lemma32Epsilon exactData errorSpectrum))
formal_statement.plain_language: For the matrix computed by finite-precision forward substitution with the computed sketch-QR preconditioner, epsilon_2 below one implies full column rank and the complete condition-number bound stated in Lemma 3.2.

informal_proof: Write YHat=A*RHatInv+DeltaY. The exact preconditioned matrix is injective because A is injective and RHatInv is invertible. Singular-value perturbation gives full rank of YHat, ||YHat||_2 <= ||A*RHatInv||_2+||DeltaY||_2, and ||YHat^dagger||_2 <= ||(A*RHatInv)^dagger||_2/(1-epsilon_2). Multiply the last two inequalities and substitute the exact definition of epsilon_2.
informal_statement: All of Lemma 3.2: full rank and the displayed quantitative condition-number bound for the finite-precision forward-substitution output.
